definitions.explanation: A white line painted on surfaces such as roads, train platforms, and sports fields. In Japan, commonly associated with platform safety lines at train stations and road markings.

examples.japanese: {白線|はくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{下|さ}がり→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please stand behind the white line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白線|はくせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The white line on the road has faded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白線|はくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧だ。
examples.english: The rule at station platforms is to wait for the train behind the white line.

notes:
USAGE: {白線|はくせん} is most familiar from the station announcement {白線|はくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{下|さ}がり→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please stand behind the white line), heard at train stations across Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白線|はくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内側|うちがわ}→内側：05449_uchigawa⟧: inside/behind the white line
- {白線|はくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw a white line
- {白線|はくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧: to cross the white line
- ⟦{横断|おうだん}{歩道|ほどう}→横断歩道：06502_oudanhodou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白線|はくせん}: white lines of a crosswalk
